contexts.text: At the same instant he wills evil, and also imperceptibly thinks it.
The internal respiration, which is tacit and imperceptible to him while he lives in the world...
The spiritual things which are of the truth of faith and good of love, imperceptible to the merely natural man, enter.
So long as he lives in the body, he feels from them... only an almost imperceptible bliss...
But this... almost imperceptible bliss... is then turned into the delight of Heaven...
The things he then spoke were imperceptible to a natural man.
In the placing of merit in works... there lies hidden... total ignorance and imperceptibility of the delight of heavenly love...
